facts.fact: The N'Djamena civil registry digitization MoU with ANATS plans to connect municipal civil-registration systems with the national identification system (SIGPTS), reported by We are Tech.

TCD.note: No count or share of people enrolled is given; the 623,000 figure is children without birth certificates.
SIGPTS assigns the number after enrolment and deduplication, not at birth registration.

facts.fact: ANATS, the National Agency for Secure Documents, already operates SIGPTS, the Integrated Population and Secure Document Management System, per We are Tech.

TCD.note: No public register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: SIGPTS assigns a unique National Identification Number to registered individuals after enrolment and deduplication, per We are Tech.
